challenges.title: A move-only RAII handle
challenges.prompt: Complete the Handle class: print `open <name>` on construction, delete copying, implement a move constructor and move assignment so ownership transfers, and print `close <name>` exactly once for each resource still owned when destroyed or overwritten. The provided main must print the expected output.
challenges.expected:
open a
open c
close a
end
close c
challenges.explain: Moving transfers ownership by clearing the source's owns_ flag, so each resource is closed exactly once. Move assignment releases the current resource first. Verified by compiling and running the solution.

challenges.title: A thread-safe counter
challenges.prompt: Make Counter safe for four threads each adding 1 twenty-five thousand times. Protect the shared value with a mutex (use RAII locking), keep get() const-correct, and print the total.
challenges.explain: Without a lock the increments race and the total is unpredictable. lock_guard releases the mutex on every path, and the mutex is mutable so a const get() can lock it. Verified by compiling and running the solution.
